title: Memory grows during a long render
report: On the 8-view setup, the renderer's memory keeps climbing during long renders until the machine runs out of memory. Short renders look fine.

title: Frame spikes every few seconds
report: Playback stutters on the 4-view setup. Average frame time looks normal, but there is a visible hitch every few seconds.

title: Frame time up after a renderer change
report: After the latest renderer change, 4K renders on the single-view setup are slower. Nothing else changed in the scene.

title: Multi-view renders slower after a change
report: Since the latest change, the 12-view setup renders much slower than before. Single-view renders seem unaffected.

title: Renderer crashes on the 12-view setup
report: Jobs on the 12-view setup fail right at start-up and produce no frames. Smaller setups still work.

title: Disk fills up during renders
report: Render machines running the 8-view setup run out of disk space after a few long jobs and the jobs get killed.

title: 4K image looks blurry after an upgrade
report: After the engine upgrade, 4K renders look soft and blurry, especially textures in the distance.

title: Memory alert on the single-view setup
report: A memory alert fired on a machine running single-view renders. Nobody knows whether the renderer caused it.

title: Stutter report without a capture
report: A user says the single-view render stutters on their machine. No trace or logs were attached.

title: 12-view jobs fail at start-up (second report)
report: Another team reports that every 12-view job dies immediately after launch with no output frames.

title: Stutter and rising memory on the 8-view setup
report: Long renders on the 8-view setup hitch every few seconds, and the machine's memory keeps climbing. Two teams filed this; nobody knows whether it is one problem or two.

title: Hitching on the 4-view setup, no traces or logs
report: Playback hitches every few seconds on the 4-view setup. Tracing is disabled on these machines and their logs were not kept.
difficulty: partial data: no trace, no logs

title: 12-view jobs die, logs lost
report: 12-view jobs die immediately. The log store for these machines was wiped, so no logs are available.

title: Soft image and slower frames after one upgrade
report: After one upgrade, 4K renders look blurry and also take longer per frame. The upgrade changed many things at once.
difficulty: two unrelated regressions in one upgrade
